decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting draws directly on the firm's deep knowledge of robust, standards-compliant specialist lighting, so it can absorb customer feedback and keep developing the line.
The spring-balanced desk lamp uses the firm's ergonomic office lighting know-how but sits at the edge of its project-based core, so the drop risk stays moderate.
As a second-generation interior luminaire it builds on existing LED and testing knowledge the firm has already absorbed, making it a low-risk core product.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship that matches the firm's in-house optics research and its strategic push toward efficient, glare-free lighting.

The marine searchlight fits the firm's marine and robust-lighting competence, but the withdrawal of the related HMI searchlight suggests the firm is consolidating this niche, which raises the risk slightly.
